newsitem.title: NETHERLANDs: Endemol expects RTL contract by end Sept.
newsitem.headline: Endemol expects RTL contract by end Sept.

text.p: TV production firm Endemol NV said on Thursday it expected to sign a new three-year contract with German broadcaster RTL Television by the end of September.
"Before the end of September a new contract will be signed with RTL," chief financial officer Aat Schouwenaar told Reuters in an interview.
A report in Dutch newspaper De Telegraaf in April, strongly contested by Endemol, suggested that negotiations with RTL were likely to lead to a far less lucrative deal for Endemol.
The Telegraaf report and disappointment over the company's first-half results triggered a slide in Endemol's share price which have since lagged behind a buoyant Dutch stock market.
Schouwenaar said Endemol expected the new agreement with RTL to retain many elements of the present contract.
That deal, expiring at the end of this year, gives RTL exclusive rights to popular stars such as Linda de Mol and right of first refusal in Germany for all Endemol programmes.
Schouwenaar noted that while RTL Television was Endemol's biggest customer in Germany, the company also delivered programmes to other stations such as SAT1, ARD and ZDF.
Germany contributes about 150 million guilders a year or just less than a quarter of Endemol's total sales.

Endemol has recently begun to spread out from its German base in Cologne, where it is close to RTL, taking a stake in Munich-based GAT which is located closer to southern-based TV stations such as PRO7.

Schouwenaar said Endemol was currently exploring opportunities to acquire stakes in television production firms based in Hamburg and Berlin where there were also growing media and entertainment industries.
